title: Tender Notice for Hiring of Security Guards at AWKUM Garden Campus – 2026
text:
```html

Tender Notice

Invitation to Bid for Security Guards

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan invites sealed bids through

e-Pak Acquisition and Disposal System (EPADS)

under the
Single Stage Two Envelopes Procedure

for hiring security guards at designated places of the

Garden Campus
.

Security Services Required

Hiring of
35 Security Guards
as per the contract
for designated places of the Garden Campus.

Tender Information

Service

Hiring of Security Guards

Quantity

35 Security Guards

Location

Garden Campus, AWKUM

Procurement Method

Single Stage Two Envelopes

Tender Fee

Rs. 3,000/- Non-Refundable

Bid Security

2% of Quoted Annual Bid Cost

Important Dates & Time

Visit of University

24 September 2026

11:00 AM – 12:00 PM

Bid Submission Deadline

5 October 2026

11:00 AM

Technical Bid Opening

5 October 2026

11:30 AM

Submission Platform

EPADS

Eligibility & Submission Requirements

Bidders must be registered with the relevant tax authorities,
including FBR, and must be active on the Income Tax and Sales
Tax Active Taxpayers List (ATL).

Firms must be registered with KPRA for provision of security
services.

Firms must be registered with the

All Pakistan Security Agencies Association (APSAA)
.

Technical Bid and Financial Bid must be submitted through EPADS.

Earnest Money/Bid Security of
2%
of the quoted
annual bid cost must be submitted in the form of Call Deposit
(CDR) from any scheduled bank of Pakistan.

The original Demand Draft/Pay Order for the tender fee and
2% CDR must be submitted physically to the Procurement Office
by the specified deadline.

Scanned copies of the tender fee and 2% CDR must also be
uploaded with the Technical and Financial Bids respectively
on EPADS.

Tender documents must be duly signed and stamped by the bidder.

Download Tender Document

Download the complete official tender notice and bidding document.

⬇ Download Tender Document (https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=18HPF2lbP4CaJ5m-igI0Mcae2kP8_LmKi)

Procurement Officer

Abdul Wali Khan University Mardan

Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan

Phone:

0937-920868

Email:

procurement@awkum.edu.pk

```
